text:
aj: Heads-up — planning an RBAC tighten for the keystore replication role next Wed. We'll remove broad kms:Decrypt from `service-account-infra` across a couple of replica regions. Want to call out possible impacts on mTLS handshakes + audit pipeline. Anyone see an obvious gap?

maya: good catch. Why the change now? Is this to close the lateral-movement vector from older instances?

aj: yes — vuln triage turned up a VM escaping risk in a dev cluster that had wide KMS decrypt perms. Prod roles were already scoped but some replica roles inherited the broad policy. This is scoped rollback to least-privilege.

sre-natalie: potential fallout: proxies and edge agents that do remote unwrap for ephemeral certs might get Unauthenticated/unable-to-decrypt errors. That can cause mTLS handshake failures between regions if the proxy tries remote unwrap and gives up too early.

paul: we should add an explicit audit field for unwrap failures so the incident team can filter quickly. Something like `event.kms_unwrap_result` = {"success"|"failure"} + `event.kms_key_region`. Also, preserve only metadata in logs (no plaintext cert material).

maya: agreed. Also change request: add an automated fallback policy in the control-plane that, on unwrap failure, retries local keystore + then a degraded TLS path that keeps control-plane connections alive (short-lived, reduced cipher list) while triggering an alert. We don't want global outages for a single region's KMS outage.

aj: drafting a rollout plan: 1) add audit field + log schema change (security review), 2) add unwrap-retry local fallback in runtime, 3) canary RBAC change in eu-west, 4) run cross-region chaos tests (simulated KMS unwrap failures) for 48h, 5) full roll. Thoughts on timeline?

paul: for the audit change propose this log snippet to owners, keep it at INFO and redact PKI material:
```json
{"ts":"$now","service":"keystore","event":{"type":"kms_unwrap_attempt","result":"failure","key":"projects/..../keys/keystore-eu","region":"eu-west1","caller":"svc-agent-proxy-1"}}
```

sre-natalie: plus we need a detection rule in Splunk/CloudWatch: if `kms_unwrap_attempt.failure` rate spikes > 1% of mTLS handshakes for 10m, auto-open incident and route to sec-oncall + infra + owners.

maya: RBAC change needs to coordinate with onboarding scripts and terraform modules. Add an `allow-unwrap-in-region` conditional so we can grant minimal perms to the proxy in the same region as the KMS key. Avoid granting cross-region decrypt by default.

aj: action items I got: a) paul to propose log schema PR (by EOD), b) maya to update terraform modules for conditional allow (tomorrow), c) natalie to add detection rule and canary test plan (this week). I'll prepare the incident playbook snippet for unwrap-failure.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline triggered: `keystore-audit-schema/v2` -> staging (build 0.3.1) :white_check_mark:

security-bot: note — please reference compliance ticket SEC-876 (encrypt-in-transit evidence) in all PRs and ensure KMS auditlog retention is >= 90 days.

aj: thanks — will loop in legal/compliance for retention. tagging @sec-oncall for awareness. :thumbsup:
